firstPlayerRule: The player who last ate a mango is the first player for the opening round.
clarifications: That player takes the white First Player action selection marker and reminder token.
Every other player receives one coin.
The first player begins each round, then play proceeds clockwise; the role passes left after the round.

sources.title: Merchants of Muziris: English rulebook

internalEvidence: The 2019 English rulebook gives the last mango eater the opening first-player role on printed page 4, with clockwise turns and leftward passing of the role on pages 8–9. Its cover and 2019 production marks match the Kolossal Games second-edition material posted by the publisher for inventory BGG 231215.
